parameters.jsCode: const deepStable=v=>{if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map(deepStable);if(v&&typeof v==="object"){const o={};for(const k of Object.keys(v).sort())o[k]=deepStable(v[k]);return o;}return v;};const VOLATILE=new Set(["versionId","updatedAt","createdAt","activeVersionId","meta","pinData","staticData","triggerCount","shared","versionCounter","credentials"]);const scrub=w=>{if(!w||typeof w!=="object")return w;const o={};for(const k of Object.keys(w).sort()){if(VOLATILE.has(k))continue;o[k]=deepStable(w[k]);}return o;};const items=$input.all();const g=items[0];const actual=scrub(items[1].json);let orig=null;if(Object.keys(g.json).includes("content")&&g.json.content)orig=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(g.json.content,"base64").toString());else if(Object.keys(g.json).includes("data")&&g.json.data)orig=JSON.parse(g.json.data);if(orig){const ordered=scrub(orig);if(JSON.stringify(ordered)===JSON.stringify(actual))g.json.github_status="same";else{g.json.github_status="different";g.json.n8n_data_stringy=JSON.stringify(actual,null,2);}g.json.content_decoded=ordered;}else{g.json.github_status="new";g.json.n8n_data_stringy=JSON.stringify(actual,null,2);}return items;

## Backup to GitHub
Backs up Sorted_Signals-tagged workflows to GitHub on a schedule.

Files land as {sanitizedName}__{workflowId}.json under gh_repo_path (flat). Old YYYY/MM/{id}.json files are left alone for manual cleanup.

Repo owner/name/path and Telegram chat ID come from the global_variables data table.

Compare scrub strips volatile fields (versionId, updatedAt, pins, etc.) so metadata-only changes do not commit.

Orphan sync (next) hard-deletes GitHub-only files matching the new naming pattern only.

Self-call per item for memory. Telegram for start/complete/fail.

parameters.jsCode: const files=$input.all();const ids=new Set($("n8n").all().map(i=>i.json.id));const orphans=[];for(const item of files){const f=item.json;if(f.type&&f.type!=="file")continue;const name=f.name||"";const m=name.match(/__([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.json$/);if(!m)continue;const id=m[1];if(ids.has(id))continue;orphans.push({json:{origin:"github",name,filePath:f.path,id,hasOrphans:true}});}if(orphans.length===0){return[{json:{hasOrphans:false}}];}return orphans;
